SELECT t1.id, t1.name, t1.category_id, t1.brand_id, t1.pic_url, ( SELECT MIN(retail_price) FROM pms_sku WHERE spu_id = t1.id AND deleted = 0 ) AS price, ( SELECT MIN(market_price) FROM pms_sku WHERE spu_id = t1.id AND deleted = 0 ) AS origin_price, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(stock) FROM pms_sku WHERE spu_id = t1.id AND deleted = 0 ), 0) AS total_stock, t1.sales, t1.real_sales, t1.virtual_sales, t1.unit, t1.detail, t1.description, t1.spu_type, CASE t1.spu_type WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '普通商品' ELSE '普通商品' END AS spu_type_desc, t1.status FROM pms_spu t1 WHERE t1.deleted = 0 AND t1.id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY FIELD(t1.id
,#{id} )
